scope: Redirect targets or CORS origins that reflect attacker-chosen cross-origin values.
exclusions: Server-side fetch of internal addresses belongs to ssrf_cloud_metadata
required_evidence: Redirect target parameter or Origin header with a cross-origin value
Browser or CORS configuration showing reflected origin with credentials
Response header evidence such as Access-Control-Allow-Origin
benign_counterexamples: Login redirect back to a same-site path
Public read-only API with wildcard CORS and no credentials
note: Seeded payload lists already cover single payload strings; write whole application scenarios instead (route, parameter, sink context), with realistic payloads of this class, at most ceil(count/families) records per family.
